note:
Nothing has been measured yet. This file is committed ahead of the measurement so the Golden Manifest's `tolerance_file` resolves and so the shape of the eventual grid is fixed before any number lands in it -- not because a threshold exists.

A tolerance is an input to validation, not an output of it. Recording the numbers a run happens to produce and calling them the acceptance criteria proves only that the run reproduced itself. So this file deliberately records no grid: `stages` is empty, and there is no `profiles` key at all, which makes every validator's `--check` refuse rather than pass vacuously -- scripts/validate-<family>-<stage>.py reads `tolerances.get("profiles", {})` and stops when the requested cell is absent. Deleting a threshold to make a run pass would be visible in the diff; there is nothing here to delete.

The reference stage is `source-f32-oracle-vs-f32-cpu`, and that name is the whole reason this family's thresholds should end up tighter than qwen3-tts's. The checkpoint is F32 throughout and the oracle runs F32 on CPU, so the comparison carries neither a dtype difference nor a device difference -- only an implementation one. docs/port-validation.md's dtype-follows-the-checkpoint rule and its least-approximating-reproducible-device rule select the same configuration here instead of pulling apart, which is what made this family attractive in the first place.

One threshold this file will never need: the token grid. docs/porting/families/omnivoice.md defines `structural_exactness` for this family as exact equality of the 8 x T grid against the oracle's, and greedy decoding makes no RNG call at all, so that gate is equality rather than a number. What gets measured here is the waveform and the step-0 generator probes.

The grid will be keyed on Quantization Profile, Execution Backend and stage, the layout tests/python/test_tolerance_coverage.py checks. That test's legacy branch -- which asserts an empty `stages` object -- is what this file currently satisfies, and its docstring names exactly this situation: a family that arrived before its grid was swept. The first measurement replaces `stages` with a real `profiles` grid and this note with the reasoning behind the figures.

Quantization is expected to be harder for this family than for any shipped so far, which is a reason to fix the shape now. A reference port measured token agreement collapsing from 100 percent to roughly 7 percent with F16 generator weights: an argmax flip at one step is committed, fed back into both branches, and conditions every later step, so error does not average out. Every profile re-passes the exact-token gate or is not shipped, and no perceptual claim substitutes for it.
